# The JetBrains Blog

> > The official JetBrains company blog covering developer tools, AI Assistant innovations, product announcements, and insights into software development practices.

JetBrains is a leading software development company known for IDEs like IntelliJ IDEA, PyCharm, and WebStorm. This blog features company news, AI Assistant developments including Junie and GPT-5 integration, insights from team members like Lana Novikova and Cassie Kozyrkov, and updates on tools like Toolbox App and JetBrains Console.

## Key Topics

- JetBrains
- AI Assistant
- Junie
- GPT-5 integration
- Developer tools
- Toolbox App
- JetBrains Console
- Kineto
- Open source
- AI management
- jetbrainsd
- IDE development
- Software development practices
- Company news
- Product announcements

- [Company | The JetBrains Blog](https://blog.jetbrains.com/blog): JetBrains company blog featuring AI Assistant, Junie, and developer tools
